en.headline: Audit finds high no-show rates at children's assessment centres
en.dek: The Audit Commission said professional assessment no-show rates ranged from 11 to 25 per cent at the eight centres, and the Department of Health missed its six-month completion target.
body: The Audit Commission has called for continued monitoring of no-show rates at children's assessment centres operated by the Department of Health and the Hospital Authority.

According to the latest audit report, the Department of Health's seven centres recorded no-show rates of 11 to 13 per cent for professional assessments of children under 12 between 2023 and 2025, rising to 13 to 16 per cent for further assessments. The Hospital Authority's centre saw rates of 19 to 25 per cent for further professional assessments of children under six.

Neither organisation has stored management data on the reasons for missed appointments. The Commission also noted that the Department of Health consistently failed to meet its target of completing professional assessments within six months between 2021 and 2025, with achievement rates of 61 to 73 per cent against a goal of more than 90 per cent.
The departments have agreed with the Audit Commission's recommendations to improve monitoring and appointment attendance.

zh.headline: 審計署指兒童測驗中心失約率高達兩成半
zh.dek: 審計報告顯示八間兒童測驗中心專業評估失約率介乎11%至25%，衛生署持續未達6個月內完成評估目標。
body: 審計署呼籲繼續監察衛生署及醫管局轄下兒童測驗中心的失約率。
最新審計報告指出，衛生署7間中心在2023至2025年間，為12歲以下兒童進行專業評估的失約率介乎11%至13%，進一步專業評估則達13%至16%。醫管局中心為6歲以下兒童進行進一步專業評估的失約率高達19%至25%。
兩個機構均無備存失約原因的管理資料。審計署亦留意到，衛生署在2021至2025年間持續未能達6個月內完成專業評估的目標，達標率僅介乎61%至73%，低於超90%的目標。
有關部門已同意審計署的建議，將加強監察以及提升預約出席率。
